whatIs: Neumorphism.io generates the CSS for an element with a neumorphic (or soft UI) style. You pick a color, adjust the size, radius, distance, intensity and blur of the shadow, and choose among four shapes: flat, concave, convex and pressed.
You copy the border-radius, background and box-shadow declarations with a button. It's a good way to quickly try this style on buttons, cards or switches.
uses: Creating a button with a soft raised effect.
Designing a card or widget with a sense of depth for a dashboard.
Generating the pressed state of a switch with the pressed shape.
caveats: Neumorphism uses very similar tones for the background and the element, which usually gives low contrast; check that borders and text stand out.
The code is for a single element and color; for a complete theme you have to repeat it and keep it consistent.
pricingNote: Free and open source, with no paid plans.
idealFor: People who want to quickly preview and copy an adjustable neumorphic shadow.
